text: dsh-plugin-claude-bridge 将 Claude Code 的项目记忆、技能目录和全局指令接入 DSH 系统提示词。它动态读取 Markdown 记忆并按类型排序，列出技能名称与描述，也会加入 ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md 内容。记忆和技能数量可设上限，各类注入均可关闭。适合希望在 DSH 中沿用 Claude Code 上下文的用户；默认读取 ~/.claude，无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-plugin-claude-bridge adds Claude Code memories, skill names and global instructions to DSH prompts. It reads local Markdown dynamically with configurable limits. Use it to carry Claude Code context into DSH; no API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 在回答时参考我在 Claude Code 中积累的项目记忆。
能把 Claude Code 的技能目录列进 DSH 的提示词吗？
我希望 DSH 自动带上 ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md 里的全局规则。
换到 DSH 后怎样继续使用 Claude Code 的记忆和技能，不用手动搬文件？
Can DSH include my Claude Code project memories in its system prompt?
I want DSH to make my Claude Code skills available in its prompt context.
dsh-plugin-claude-bridge 的功能「项目记忆注入」：按当前工作目录定位 Claude Code 项目记忆目录，读取 Markdown 记忆并按类型优先级排序后加入动态系统提示词；每次请求重新读取，且受最大字节数限制。
dsh-plugin-claude-bridge 的功能「技能目录」：扫描 Claude Code 技能目录及可选的额外目录，读取技能名称和描述并加入动态提示词目录；最多列出配置的数量。
dsh-plugin-claude-bridge 的功能「全局指令」：惰性读取 ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md，并将内容作为全局指令区段加入 DSH 系统提示词。
让 DSH 的系统提示词自动包含我本机的 Claude 全局说明。
Keep my Claude Code project memory available to DSH without copying files.
dsh-plugin-claude-bridge README · dsh-plugin-claude-bridge：Bridge Claude Code's memory, skills, and configuration into DeepSeek Harness -- zero migration, full compatibility.

dsh-plugin-claude-bridge README · What it does：Reads Claude Code's standard file locations directly -- no migration scripts, no file copying, no symlinks:

- `~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/*.md` -- Injects memories as dynamic system prompt context
- `~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` -- Adds skills to the available catalog
- `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` -- Injects global instructions into system prompt

dsh-plugin-claude-bridge README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile your-profile add dsh-plugin-claude-bridge
```

dsh-plugin-claude-bridge README · Configuration：Works out of the box with zero configuration. All options are optional:

```yaml
- id: claude-bridge
  name: dsh-plugin-claude-bridge
  config:
    claudeHome: '~/.claude'

dsh-plugin-claude-bridge README · Memory injection：Claude Code stores memories as individual markdown files with YAML frontmatter. This plugin reads all memory files, sorts them by type priority (feedback > project > reference > user), and injects them as a dynamic system prompt context section. The context is re-read on each request, so new memories take effect immediately.
dsh-plugin-claude-bridge README · Skill catalog：Skills from `~/.claude/skills/` are discovered and their names and descriptions are injected as a catalog in the system prompt.

dsh-plugin-claude-bridge README · Global instructions：The content of `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` is injected as an early system prompt section (order 5), so global instructions and model routing rules are preserved.
